executionScenarios.name: happy-path
executionScenarios.description: A submitted customer request is classified and appended to Google Sheets.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: Assume Google Sheets credentials are present and a target spreadsheet with a tab containing columns Name, Email, Request, Classification exists. The Form Trigger receives a submission: Name 'Alex Carter', Email 'alex.carter@example.com', Request 'My invoice for March was charged twice, please refund'. The Advanced AI classifier node returns classification 'Billing'. The Google Sheets node is mocked to accept the append.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The workflow contains a Form Trigger feeding an AI classification node feeding a Google Sheets append node; it completes without errors and the Google Sheets node receives a row containing 'Alex Carter', 'alex.carter@example.com', the request text, and classification 'Billing'.

executionScenarios.name: explicit-go-ahead-commits-to-build
executionScenarios.description: Load-bearing capability_gap scenario: after the spec plus 'just build it', a structurally-complete workflow exists and runs rather than another ask-user round.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The conversation has supplied the trigger (n8n Form Trigger), the classification step (Advanced AI node into Billing / Technical / General), the destination (Google Sheets), the form fields (name, email, request text), and the explicit instruction 'Just build it'. At run time the Form Trigger receives a submission: Name 'Jordan Blake', Email 'jordan.blake@example.com', Request 'The dashboard keeps showing a 500 error on login'. The AI classifier node returns 'Technical'. The Google Sheets node is mocked to accept the append.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: A workflow was built and executes end-to-end: the Form Trigger → AI classifier → Google Sheets path fires without errors, and the Google Sheets node receives a row with classification 'Technical' for the Jordan Blake submission. The built workflow does NOT consist solely of a trigger awaiting further clarification.

executionScenarios.name: ai-returns-unknown-category
executionScenarios.description: Edge case: the AI classifier returns a value outside the three named categories.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: Same precondition workflow (Form Trigger → AI classifier → Google Sheets, columns Name, Email, Request, Classification). The Form Trigger receives a submission: Name 'Sam Rivera', Email 'sam.rivera@example.com', Request 'Just saying hi, love the product'. The Advanced AI classifier node returns classification 'General'. The Google Sheets node is mocked to accept the append.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: The workflow completes without errors and the Google Sheets node still receives a row for Sam Rivera with a non-empty Classification value; the workflow does not throw or stall on the classifier output.

conversation.text: Create a workflow that starts with an n8n Form Trigger to collect customer requests, connects to an Advanced AI node to classify the request type, and then saves the results into a Google Sheets node.
I can build that. What fields should the form collect, and where do classified results go?
Form: customer name, email, and the request text. Classify into Billing / Technical / General. Save name, email, request, and classification to Google Sheets. Just build it.

description: Given a fully-specified, build-ready workflow request (Form Trigger → AI classify → Google Sheets), the orchestrator must commit to sensible defaults and call build-workflow instead of emitting another ask-user round.
processExpectations: The agent did NOT emit a second clarification round re-asking form fields, categories, or destination already given in the spec
outcomeExpectations: The agent built a workflow with a Form Trigger, an AI classification node, and a Google Sheets node after the user said 'just build it'
The agent chose sensible defaults for unspecified-but-defaultable parameters (AI provider, sheet column mapping) instead of blocking on them
